backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing admin authentication with fixed credentials (ID: 97SKY80, password: SKY8084), role-based access control via mixins, user profile management, and query methods for verifying admin credentials and granting admin roles.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two high-confidence features: debugging /admin route authentication flow errors and adding error boundaries to AdminPage for better error handling and diagnostics.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components for authentication, product management, checkout flow, admin dashboard, and mobile-optimized UI with touch-friendly interactions and Indian rupee pricing.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color palette defining light and dark theme variables for background, foreground, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, border, and sidebar colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with PWA meta tags, viewport configuration for mobile optimization, theme color, manifest link, and app icons for Maa Bhawani General Store & Banking Point.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA manifest defining app name, icons (192x192, 512x512, 180x180), standalone display mode, portrait orientation, and theme colors for Maa Bhawani General Store.
frontend/public/service-worker.js: Service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets and network-first for API calls, with install/activate lifecycle management and offline fallback support.
frontend/src/App.tsx: TanStack Router configuration defining routes for home, checkout, order confirmation, store details, admin dashboard, billing, and settings pages with Layout wrapper.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: Authorization component that checks admin status via useIsCallerAdmin hook, displays login dialog for admin ID/password authentication, handles Internet Identity integration, and shows detailed error states with principal copying and retry functionality.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductForm: Form component for adding new products with fields for name, category, price, barcode, and image upload. Includes validation, duplicate barcode checking, and upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductList: Displays a table of all products with images, details, and delete functionality. Includes loading skeletons and confirmation dialogs for deletion.
frontend/src/components/BillHistoryTable: Shows searchable table of all generated bills with view, print, and CSV export functionality. Includes filtering by bill number, customer name, or phone.
frontend/src/components/BillTemplate.tsx: Renders a printable bill template with shop details, customer info, itemized list, and totals formatted for 80mm thermal printer.
frontend/src/components/CallUsButton.tsx: Fixed floating button in bottom-right corner that initiates a phone call to the shop number (9142876085).
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: Side drawer displaying cart items with quantities, prices, and actions for checkout or clearing cart. Includes swipe-to-close gesture support.
frontend/src/components/CategoryFilter.t: Horizontal scrollable list of category filter buttons with active state highlighting for product filtering.
Alert component displaying delivery policy information: free within 1km, ₹20/km beyond.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: React error boundary component that catches rendering errors and displays detailed error information with reset and navigation options.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying store information, contact details with phone and map links, delivery info, and a copyright notice with attribution to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header component with navigation, logo, authentication button, and shopping cart icon with item count badge; includes CartDrawer integration and handles login/logout functionality.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Layout wrapper component that combines Header, Footer, and CallUsButton with a gradient background and centers main content in a container.
frontend/src/components/MobileRechargeSe: Mobile recharge form component with banner image, allowing users to enter phone number, select operator from predefined list, and submit recharge orders with validation.
frontend/src/components/PaymentQRCode.ts: Payment QR code display component showing the amount to pay, a QR code image, and step-by-step UPI payment instructions.
frontend/src/components/PhoneNumberSetup: Empty component file with no content.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Product card component displaying product image, name, category badge, and price with an 'Add to Cart' button that requires authentication.
frontend/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx: Product grid component with category filtering that displays products in a responsive grid layout with loading skeletons and empty state handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, initializing access control with admin token and invalidating dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing AuthClient creation, login/logout flow, identity state, and login status with configurable options for idle handling and derivation origin.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend operations including products, cart, orders, recharge orders, bills, authentication, and shop settings. Provides both query hooks for fetching data and mutation hooks for modifying data with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProfile.ts: Empty file, likely a placeholder for future user profile functionality.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark theme color palettes (warm, earthy grocery store theme), touch-friendly mobile interactions, and print styles optimized for 80mm thermal receipt printing.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClientProvider for React Query and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, then renders the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page displaying statistics (products, orders, bills, revenue), with tabs for managing products and viewing bill history. Includes navigation to billing and settings pages with error handling.
frontend/src/pages/AdminSettingsPage.tsx: Admin settings page for customizing shop slogan with live preview using a mock bill template. Displays fixed shop information and allows saving slogan changes with validation.
frontend/src/pages/BillingPage.tsx: Point-of-sale billing interface supporting manual barcode entry and camera scanning to add products to a bill. Manages bill line items with quantity controls, customer details, bill generation, and printing functionality.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Checkout page component that collects delivery details (name, phone, address, distance), calculates total price with delivery fees, validates form inputs, and submits orders via the backend actor.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main landing page component that displays a store banner image, mobile recharge section, and a product grid for browsing groceries.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Order confirmation page that displays order success message, order ID, payment QR code, and next steps for completing payment and delivery.
frontend/src/pages/StoreDetailsPage.tsx: Store information page displaying contact details, location map, delivery policy, store hours, and available services for Maa Bhawani General Store.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes using OKLCH color space, container settings, border radius variables, font families, shadows, and animation keyframes.
project_state.json: Project state metadata tracking known issues with the Admin Panel /admin route error, existing debugging features, and pending verification of backend actor's verifyAdmin method.
